title: A3 development snapshot B01-dev-A3-009
summary: Exact source and resource snapshot registered before this development attempt.
mechanism: Public image-derived tagged positions and device I/O feed candidate reconciliation. A durable conventional scheduler selects operations and an actual local LLM supplies transport clearance, speed and avoidance objectives. Shared IK, quintic joint trajectories and contact-based Panda grasping execute motions. Candidate code runs inside WSL bubblewrap through JSON IPC. World/evaluator and local model gateway remain outside. Every consequential action is durably recorded and current observations reconcile outcomes. These implementations are under calibration; sensor/trajectory/isolation unit checks do not establish full readiness or comparative benefit.
